text: It is the father’s gene that decides whether the baby is a boy or a girl.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.note: 2012 survey; older data. 63% answered correctly (true). NSF reports the share answering correctly; don’t-know is counted on the wrong side.

truthSource.label: MedlinePlus Genetics, Sex chromosomes
truthSource.oneLine: The father’s sperm carries either an X or a Y chromosome, which determines the baby’s sex.
